# Military.com

> Military.com is the leading online resource for active-duty service members, veterans, and military families seeking news, benefits guidance, career opportunities, and military lifestyle information.

Military.com provides comprehensive coverage of all five branches of the U.S. Armed Forces (Army, Navy, Air Force, Marine Corps, Coast Guard, and Space Force) along with detailed resources on military pay, education benefits like the GI Bill, veterans health care through the VA and Tricare, and employment opportunities. The site combines breaking military news with practical guides for service members and veterans navigating benefits, careers, and transitions to civilian life.

## Key Topics

- Military benefits
- Veteran benefits
- GI Bill
- Military pay
- VA health care
- Tricare
- Military careers
- Armed Forces branches
- Military news
- Veteran jobs
- PTSD support
- Military fitness
- Defense news
- Military operations
- Veteran stories

## Military Branches & Operations

- [US Army News, Army Pay & Fitness Resources](https://www.military.com/army): U.S. Army news, pay information, fitness resources and career guidance
- [US Navy News, Navy Pay, Fitness Resources](https://www.military.com/navy): U.S. Navy news, pay, fitness resources and naval operations information
- [US Air Force News, Pay, Fitness Resources](https://www.military.com/air-force): U.S. Air Force news, pay, promotions and fitness training resources
- [US Marine Corps News, Marine Pay & Fitness Resources](https://www.military.com/marine-corps): U.S. Marine Corps news, pay, promotions and fitness training resources
- [US Coast Guard News, Coast Guard Pay & Fitness Resources](https://www.military.com/coast-guard): U.S. Coast Guard news, pay, fitness resources and mission information
- [United States Space Force](https://www.military.com/space-force): U.S. Space Force overview, history, recruitment and operations information

## Military & Veteran Benefits

- [Military Benefits News and Resources](https://www.military.com/benefits): Military and veteran benefits information covering health, education and pay
- [Military Pay, Resources, Articles, Military Pay Charts](https://www.military.com/benefits/military-pay): Military pay charts, calculators and BAH/BAS rates and allowances
- [GI Bill, Montgomery and Post 9/11 GI Bills](https://www.military.com/education/gi-bill): GI Bill programs guide covering Post-9/11, Montgomery and education benefits
- [Veterans Health Care, Guides to the VA](https://www.military.com/benefits/veterans-health-care): Veterans health care guidance covering VA benefits, PTSD and caregiver support
- [Tricare, Tricare Programs](https://www.military.com/benefits/tricare): Tricare health insurance overview and program coverage information

## Military News & Analysis

- [Military Daily News, Military Headlines](https://www.military.com/daily-news): Daily military news updates covering gear, breaking news and international events
- [Military News and Opinion Articles](https://www.military.com/daily-news/opinion): Military opinion and editorial articles on veterans benefits and policy
- [Military Videos](https://www.military.com/video): Military videos featuring Army, Navy, Air Force, Marines and Space Force
- [Military Podcasts](https://www.military.com/podcasts): Military podcasts covering news, benefits and military lifestyle topics

## Home & Hub

- [Military and Veteran Benefits, News, Veteran Jobs](https://www.military.com): Military.com homepage providing military benefits, news, jobs and discounts
